description: This file defines a PHP class 'CustomFieldSearchFilterParams' which extends 'FilterParams'. It provides a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering custom fields in the PIM (Personnel Information Management) plugin of the OrangeHRM system. The class includes properties for 'screen' and 'fieldNumbers' with getter and setter methods, and a constant defining allowed sort fields.

classes.name: CustomFieldSearchFilterParams
classes.description: DTO class for filtering custom fields in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, allowing filtering by screen and field numbers, with predefined allowed sort fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the sort field to 'cf.name'.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'screen' property.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the value of the 'screen' property.

methods.name: getFieldNumbers
methods.description: Returns the current array of field numbers.

methods.name: setFieldNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of field numbers.
